verdict.rationale: Lever has an onboarding product (I-9 verification, form creation, tax documents) and a generic integrations marketplace, but nothing in the evidence shows a signed offer handing off to onboarding or to HRIS/payroll integrations that carry new-hire data without re-entry. The webhooks and Data API are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, and the marketplace claim names no HRIS or payroll connectors.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
